name: Quality saving recheck part
info: This part recheck if the quality parameters have been saved to the shift documently correclty.

name: Recheck direct quality after grace / failures
Read saved shifts for direct quality reconciliation
Prepare saved shifts + route quality recheck
Read current grade categories for recheck
Query shift quality directly again
Update saved code-wise quality (conditional)
Save direct quality fields to shifts
Direct code-wise quality saved
func: const r=msg.payload;if(r?.acknowledged!==true)throw Error('Direct quality update not acknowledged.');if(r.matchedCount!==1)return null;return {payload:{updated:true,shiftId:String(msg.directQualityProduction._id)}};

name: Direct quality recheck failed: retry later
Safe direct quality error
func: return {payload:{updated:false,message:'Direct shift quality recheck failed; will retry.',phase:msg.error?.source?.name}};

name: Retry quality report copies every minute
Find Keda quality missing its report copy
Build category / design / grade report documents
Confirm report / mark source version
func: if(msg.payload?.acknowledged!==true)throw Error('Quality report write not acknowledged.');const d=msg.sourceShift;msg.payload=[{_id:d._id,'lineStats.qualityUpdatedAt':d.lineStats.qualityUpdatedAt},{$set:{'lineStats.qualityReportSourceUpdatedAt':d.lineStats.qualityUpdatedAt,'lineStats.qualityReportCopiedAt':new Date().toISOString()}}];return msg;

name: Quality report copied
func: if(msg.payload?.acknowledged!==true)throw Error('Cannot mark quality report copy.');return {payload:{saved:msg.payload.matchedCount===1,collection:'quality_reports',reportId:msg.qualityReport._id}};
